correctness.rationale: The explicit 11-vertex standard Mycielskian C5 has 20 edges. Direct component-size enumeration across all 2^11 masks gives 102 nonempty Ind1 faces and 312 nonempty Ind2 faces. The fetched certificate proof/relative_collapse.json contains 105 lower/upper face pairs, and proof/verify_groetzsch.py checks each lower face has exactly one remaining strict coface (the upper), with one more vertex, until precisely Ind1 remains. The fetched 50-edge acyclic matching on Ind1 has one critical 0-cell and one critical 2-cell; the general Mycielskian suspension and Ind(C5)≃S1 independently support Ind1≃S2. The independent verifier for the broader n=3..6 result also reconstructed 105 genuine pairs at n=5. This proves a finite simple-homotopy result, not an all-n theorem.
